paragraphs: Tom and Lily go to the pool with Mom. Mom opens the door. A sign is on the door. It says: "Put your shoes here." "Where is the box?" asks Lily. "Next to the door," says Mom. Tom puts his shoes in the box. Lily puts her shoes in the box. She puts her bag next to them.

Now they see a sign. It is next to the water. It says: "Walk, please." "Can we run?" asks Tom. "Look at the sign," says Mom. Tom looks and smiles. "We walk here!" he says. They walk to a small pool. A sign says: "You can swim here." Lily and Tom swim with Mom.

Then Tom sees a big pool. A red sign says: "No swimming here." "Can I swim here?" asks Tom. "No, it is for big people," says Mom. They sit on a chair. A sign says: "You can drink water here." They drink the water. Mom smiles. "Do you like the pool?" asks Mom. "Yes!" says Lily. The signs are good.
text.summary: Mom takes Tom and Lily to the swimming pool. They read five signs, and each sign tells them what to do.
